column2: Its mail stays on the server and is held in memory only while Quatrelle runs: none of it is written to this computer, and each message downloads when you open it. Mail you send goes straight to the server; only mail that can't go yet (while offline) waits, and it's lost with changes made offline if Quatrelle closes first (you're asked). Calendars, contacts and notes on a server stay there; those kept only in Quatrelle are lost when it closes.
